boundary: The three nodes and the handoff route use provisional geometry and are not an operating route, permit or current performance claim.

nodes.label_zh: 众智园企业到岗与装卸
nodes.spatial_interface: enterprise mobility desk, shuttle waiting, loading curb and protected fire/access route
denominators: protected fire and accessible route minutes
nodes.acceptance: grouped demand is recorded and the curb is cleared within the declared window without reducing the public route
nodes.non_ai_equivalent: paper register, staffed marshal and published public-transport route
nodes.refusal: refuse a booking when a responsible marshal, capacity record or protected route is missing
nodes.fallback: freeze booking and return the request to public transport or a staffed desk

nodes.label_zh: AI 原点社区日常到达
nodes.spatial_interface: community service desk, continuous accessible route, rain shelter and non-digital request point
nodes.acceptance: the same daily trip can be completed through a human, telephone or paper route without requiring an app or enterprise account
nodes.non_ai_equivalent: walk-in desk, telephone, paper wayfinding and public transport
nodes.refusal: disable the recommendation when the digital option is required for basic access or an observed group loses an equivalent route
nodes.fallback: keep the staffed route open, record the refusal and return to P0 route review

nodes.label_zh: 大钟寺轨道换乘与路缘分流
nodes.spatial_interface: station wayfinding, bicycle parking, walking crossing, enterprise entrance and timed curb
nodes.acceptance: rail transfer, loading and resident return remain separated, with a dated alternative route whenever a curb window is refused
nodes.non_ai_equivalent: station timetable, staffed wayfinding and public crossing information
nodes.refusal: do not reserve a curb window when capacity, accessibility, fire clearance or transfer responsibility is unknown
nodes.fallback: remove feeder demand, keep the public route open and dispatch staffed wayfinding

handoffs.handoff: rail or bus arrival to accessible ground route and community desk
public route or enterprise trip with grouped demand and protected curb window

gates: provisional geometry is versioned and recalculation is ready
grouped demand and consent boundary are dated
safety and accessibility route audit is complete
receiving role and maintenance response are named
negative cases and non-AI equivalents are reviewed
